title: Compliance-Mapping Row Schema (v0.1)
description: Implementation-neutral JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for one row of an agentic-AI governance evidence mapping. Defined and published as part of the Phionyx Evaluation Standard v0.2 supplement (standard/phionyx_Evaluation_Standard_v0.2.md). The schema is intended to be reusable by any agentic-AI runtime that can publish reviewer-runnable evidence; field-level reusability is not required, format-level reusability is.
_note_assessment_signal: assessment_signal is required-on-Full per the allOf rule below; for Partial and Gap rows it is permitted to be omitted.

framework.description: Source framework's identifier and version (e.g., 'EU AI Act 2024/1689', 'NIST AI RMF 1.0', 'OWASP Agentic AI Threats v1.0', 'ISO/IEC 42001:2023').

clause.description: Specific clause within the framework (e.g., 'Article 12(1) — Record-keeping', 'GOVERN 1.1', 'A.6.2.2', 'T1 Memory Poisoning'). Free text; no enum because clause naming differs across frameworks.

coverage.description: Runtime-scoped coverage label, read as Runtime-Full / Runtime-Partial / Runtime-Gap. 'Full' means the runtime supplies a complete technical mechanism for the runtime-scoped portion of the framework clause, under the assumptions and deployer programme stated in the row; 'Partial' means the runtime supplies part of the technical mechanism; 'Gap' means the runtime does not supply this mechanism, by design or due to scope. NEVER asserts legal, regulatory, or third-party conformance.

coverage_scope.description: Free-text qualifier explicitly stating the scope of the coverage label (e.g., 'runtime mechanism only; legal obligation requires deployer programme'). Required so that a 'Full' row cannot be read as a certification of the obligation as a whole.

mechanisms.description: Specific runtime mechanisms (file paths, function names, contract identifiers, schema URIs) that contribute to the clause. Permitted to be empty only on Gap rows.

evidence.description: Reviewer-reproducible artefact identifiers, typically commit-pinned URLs or paths. Permitted to be empty only on Gap rows.

deployer_responsibility.description: Non-empty string describing what the deploying organisation must supply for the mapping to hold. Required on every row regardless of coverage. A Full row with an empty deployer_responsibility field is a schema violation.

last_verified.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) marking the most recent successful run of the row's reproduction commands.

assumptions.description: Conditions under which the row applies (e.g., 'Single-tenant deployment', 'Phionyx Core SDK >= v0.3.0'). Optional on Gap rows.

authored_by.description: Identifier of the row's author (organisation, individual handle, or runtime project name) so reviewer disagreements can be attributed precisely.

assessment_signal.description: For Full rows, the specific channel, metric, or composite the row's coverage claim is interpreted against (e.g. 'phi_cognitive', 'capability_budget', 'integrity.canonical_json_hash_chain'). Required on Full rows; permitted to be omitted on Partial or Gap rows. A Full row without assessment_signal is a schema violation.

extensions.description: Optional object whose contents are framework- or runtime-specific. The top-level row schema sets additionalProperties:false, so anonymous fields outside the required set are rejected; controlled extensions live inside this object, whose internal structure is intentionally not constrained at the protocol level. This pattern allows new fields to evolve without weakening the row format.

examples._comment: Full (runtime-scoped) row binding EU AI Act Article 12(1) to a Governed Response Envelope. See examples/evidence/eu_ai_act_article_12_full_row.json for the standalone file.
examples.coverage_scope: Full only with respect to the runtime's record-generation mechanism; legal obligation as a whole requires deployer programme.
examples.deployer_responsibility: The deployer is responsible for log retention, periodic chain-integrity verification, documented procedures linking audit replay to corrective action, post-market monitoring of audit availability, and signing-key management.
assumptions: Ed25519 signing key managed by the deployer's KMS

examples._comment: Gap row: EU AI Act Article 10 has no runtime mechanism by construction. See examples/evidence/eu_ai_act_article_10_gap_row.json.
examples.coverage_scope: Not addressable by the runtime; data-governance obligations attach to training-time and deployment-time data flows outside the runtime's scope.
examples.deployer_responsibility: The deployer is responsible for training-data lineage, dataset documentation, data-protection impact assessments, and any contractual mechanisms with upstream data sources. These cannot be satisfied by the runtime.
